pick.headline: USSR announces it will boycott the Los Angeles Olympics
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of May 9, 1984, carried Moscow TASS in English: the USSR National Olympic Committee voted unanimously not to go to Los Angeles, citing an 'anti-Soviet campaign' and no security guarantees.
